hooks.name: Session Reset
hooks.description: Clears the per-session state the other hooks accumulate: truncates the agent edit journal (target/.kiro-session-edits) and removes any leftover report. Replaces the former Session Baseline hook, which recorded content hashes so the Stop hook could infer what the session changed — an inference that answered 'did anything change this file?' and therefore attributed the IDE's and other sessions' edits to the agent. bin/edit-journal.sh records the writes directly, so the hashes and their failure mode are gone. Silent always; fails open. Logic: bin/session-reset.sh.
